prompt: A hillside of wet gorse and heather, a low arch of grey dwarven stonework half buried in the slope, mossed over, deliberately built and long abandoned, small footprints in the mud leading straight to it
motion: Rain runs down the mossed stone. The camera pushes slowly in on the arch until the carving on it begins to resolve.
say: The trail ended at a door that should not have been there. Dwarven work, three hundred years old at least, and sealed from the outside.
sfx: Rain on stone, wind across a hillside, water dripping in a hollow space
